stories.headline: President Lee Jae-myung launches aggressive campaign against real estate speculation
stories.summary: President Lee intensified efforts to combat real estate speculation through social media warnings, threats to end tax breaks for multiple homeowners, and promises to make holding multiple properties 'impossible.' stories.headline: President Lee meets major conglomerate leaders to push youth employment and regional investment
stories.summary: President Lee hosted leaders from Samsung, Hyundai, LG, and other major conglomerates at Cheong Wa Dae, urging them to expand youth hiring, support startups, and invest beyond the capital region. Business leaders pledged 300 trillion won in investments and commitments for 51,600 new jobs.

stories.headline: Major South Korean crypto exchange accidentally distributes $40 billion in bitcoin
stories.summary: Bithumb, one of South Korea's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, mistakenly sent over $40 billion worth of bitcoin to customers as promotional rewards due to employee error. The exchange recovered 99.7% of the funds within hours and restricted trading for affected customers.

stories.headline: US Congress investigates South Korean regulators over alleged discrimination against American tech companies
stories.summary: The House Judiciary Committee opened a formal investigation into South Korean regulators' treatment of US tech companies, issuing a subpoena to e-commerce giant Coupang. Lawmakers allege discriminatory enforcement by agencies including the Korea Fair Trade Commission that violates recent US-Korea trade agreements.

stories.headline: President Lee's approval rating rises to 63 percent
stories.summary: A National Barometer survey showed President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating increased to 63 percent, marking its highest level in around six months. The rating increase came amid his active policy campaigns and public messaging efforts.

articles.title: Lee's approval rating edges up to 63%: poll

stories.headline: Samsung ends software support for Galaxy S21 flagship phones from 2021
stories.summary: Samsung officially discontinued software updates for its Galaxy S21 series phones launched in 2021, fulfilling its four-year update promise. The S21, S21+, and S21 Ultra will no longer receive major Android updates or security patches, though the S21 FE continues to receive support.

stories.headline: South Korea advances stablecoin legislation framework
stories.summary: South Korea's Digital Asset Basic Act, including legal framework for stablecoin issuance, is expected to pass in the first quarter of 2026. The legislation would authorize KRW-backed stablecoins for the first time, ending nine years of prohibition on local cryptocurrency launches.

articles.title: Korea's Stablecoin Moment: How Fintech and Banks Are Racing to Build the New Digital Money Infrastructure

stories.headline: Police investigate former presidential chief of staff in martial law probe
stories.summary: Police questioned former presidential chief of staff Chung Jin-suk over his alleged role in former President Yoon Suk-yeol's brief martial law declaration in late 2024. Chung attended Cabinet meetings before and after the decree was imposed.
